WE’RE PROTEUS SPORTS GROUP

SPORT BRINGS
US TOGETHER.

Our goal is simple: make sport accessible and enjoyable for everyone. We’re a Christchurch coaching team that cares about the people as much as the game.

QUALITY COACHING. STRONGER COMMUNITIES.

WHY WE DO IT

IT STARTS WITH
A GREAT EXPERIENCE.

A positive first experience can open up a lifetime of sport. A thoughtful coach can give a player the confidence to try again. A shared game can bring a community closer.

That’s what drives us. We partner with preschools, schools, clubs and community organisations to deliver coaching that helps people participate, develop and enjoy being active.

THE PROTEUS WAY

01 / SIMPLICITY

Make it easy.

Clear communication and end-to-end coaching support, built around what your people need.

02 / QUALITY

Make it count.

Professional coaches who bring purpose, energy and care to their sessions.

03 / COMMUNITY

Make it for everyone.

Welcoming sporting environments that encourage connection and participation.
